plugins.description: AgentBBS cross-host agent federation for ruflo (ADR-164). Phase 1 exposes room coordination — federation_bbs_register / federation_bbs_publish / federation_bbs_watch / federation_bbs_human_join. Phase 2 (v3.40.0) adds signed cross-host federation — federation_bbs_identity (persistent Ed25519 node identity), federation_bbs_peer_add (pin a peer by nodeId + public key), federation_bbs_peers (audit/unpin), federation_bbs_serve (read-only pull endpoint), and federation_bbs_sync (pull pinned peers and union-merge what verifies). Every merged envelope is Ed25519-verified against a pinned key; unsigned/misattributed/oversize/over-hop envelopes are dropped and counted. Transport is HTTP pull and works on any network (Tailscale, LAN, VPN, loopback) — no tailnet required. Coordinates work ownership via claim messages (ClaimIssued/Released/Handoff/Ack). agentbbs lives in optionalDependencies; every handler gracefully degrades to {degraded:true} when the package is missing (ADR-150 pattern). As a mod (ADR-445 pattern): a tighten-only tool guard, a local slash command, and a status file the console shows.

agentTrim.title: Hide unused agent types
agentTrim.description: Keep agent types the project does not use out of the model's agent listing, to save prompt tokens (measured about 4,000 fewer per request with 59 of 69 types hidden). A hidden type the prompt does not name is also refused when spawned. Always kept: built-in agents, coder, reviewer, tester, planner, researcher, any type used in the last 30 days, any in agentTrimKeep. A type named in the prompt can still be spawned, but in a headless session it is not added back to the listing: use agentTrimKeep to keep one reliably. Off by default.

agentTrimKeep.title: Agent types to never hide
agentTrimKeep.description: Comma-separated agent type names that agentTrim must keep offered.

agentModels.title: Model per agent type
agentModels.description: Comma-separated type=model pairs, for example Explore=haiku,general-purpose=sonnet. When a subagent of that type is spawned with no model chosen, it runs on this one (haiku, sonnet, opus, inherit, or a full claude- model id). Covers built-in types and other plugins' agents, whose definitions you cannot edit, and workflow agents (Claude Code 2.1.300 or later). A model the call already chose is kept; forks and teammates are left alone. Empty (the default) is off.

deliveryScreen.title: Screen peer deliveries and outgoing messages
deliveryScreen.description: Drop a delivery from a peer, relay or webhook that carries prompt-injection phrasing, and refuse to send a message to another agent that carries a secret shape (key, token) or a US social security number. In-process pattern screen: no network, no model. Tighten-only; your own Remote Control prompts are never screened. Off by default.

compactCarry.title: Carry swarm and claims state through compaction
compactCarry.description: When the conversation is compacted, tell the summary to keep one short block (600 characters at most): the live swarm id, its topology word and agent count, the ids and status of open claims, the last route agent, and the budget and policy words. Built only from validated ids and fixed words, never prompt text, tool inputs, paths or file contents; nothing is carried when no swarm or claim is open, or when the block fails a secret or injection screen. Appended to what you typed after /compact. Off by default.

rureOffer.title: Offer ruRE for binaries the model reads
rureOffer.description: When the model reads or writes an executable, library, Electron .asar or CUDA file (.exe .dll .so .dylib .node .asar .cubin .fatbin .ptx .evm .bytecode) inside the project, add one line beneath that answer saying ruRE can look inside it without running it, and how. Offer only: it never runs ruRE, never denies or changes a tool call, and names at most three files a turn and twelve a session, each once. The line holds only validated project-relative paths and fixed words, never file contents. Does nothing when the session has no ruRE tool or the answer is a subagent's. Off by default.

compactSnapshot.title: Snapshot the transcript before compaction, reload ruflo state after
compactSnapshot.description: When the main conversation is compacted, write the transcript about to be summarized to .claude-flow/sessions/compactions/snapshot-<n>.jsonl: each message's role, its text cut to 2,000 characters, and tool call names and ids; never tool inputs or outputs; a line with a secret shape or injection phrase is stored as [redacted]; at most 400 messages and 2 MiB, ten files, the oldest overwritten. The compaction is never blocked, delayed or rewritten. The next prompt then gets one context block of at most 2,000 characters: lessons that matched a prompt this session, the latest loop outcomes, open swarm and claim ids, and the snapshot's path. Only in a ruflo project (.claude-flow/, which ruflo init gitignores). On by default; set false to turn it off.

learningLoop.title: Verified-outcome learning loop
learningLoop.description: Record each main-loop turn (the tools it called, in order) and decide its outcome only from a test, build, typecheck or lint command's exit status after the turn's last edit; with no such run the turn is unverified. Turns go to .claude-flow/data/verified-trajectories.jsonl; ruflo hooks verified-ingest (also run by hooks_route and hooks_session-end) trains SONA on verified turns only. Adds at most three cited lessons it learned, at or above the 0.6 routing gate, to a prompt they match. Never denies, rewrites or delays a tool call, runs no process and calls no model. Only in a ruflo project (.claude-flow/). On by default; set false to turn it off.

capabilityProbe.title: Capability probe
capabilityProbe.description: Record the engine version and which of this mod's events actually fired, and show it as one line in /ruflo-mods (probe: engine ... · events fired n/m · never fired: ...). Observability only: never denies, rewrites or delays anything. Off by default.

sessionRollup.title: Session rollup ledger
sessionRollup.description: At session end, append one record of counters (tools called, routed, tightened, denied, agent spawns, cost rung, probe count) to a capped user-global ledger (last 50 sessions, under 32 KB) and show the last few in /ruflo-mods. Never stores prompt text, tool inputs, paths or file contents. Observability only: never denies, rewrites or delays anything. Off by default.

sessionAttention.title: Session attention row
sessionAttention.description: Show one row in /ruflo-mods with the ruflo-console's attention counts (sessions waiting for approval, with a question, failed, or finished and unread), read from the small summary file the console keeps in .claude-flow/console/. Four counts only; no session title, path or transcript text. Observability only: never denies, rewrites or delays anything. Off by default.

grounding.title: Show RuvNet Brain status
grounding.description: Show one line in /ruflo-mods saying whether the optional third-party ruvnet-brain plugin (github.com/stuinfla/ruvnet-brain) is installed and enabled: on, not installed, installed but disabled, or unknown. Reads installed_plugins.json and your settings; detect-only: never calls, installs, blocks or rewrites anything, and ruflo works the same without that plugin. Off by default.

contextDelegation.title: Automatic context delegation
contextDelegation.description: When the model reads a whole 14-120 KB file for an analysis prompt (one that routes to research or review and asks for no change), hand that read to a no-tools haiku completion that returns cited passages, check every quote against the file, and show the model only those passages with a header saying how to read the rest. The real Read always runs first, so edits still work, and any failure shows the whole file as before. Subagent reads, ranged reads, second reads of a file and change requests are never delegated. "off" (default): nothing changes. "observe": nothing the model sees changes; record what would have been delegated in .claude-flow/metrics/context-delegation.json. "enforce": delegate. Uses your session's own credentials for the haiku call.

modTrust.title: Mod trust gate
modTrust.description: How ruflo treats a hooks module installed or hot-reloaded after it (a mod Claude wrote, say). "observe" (default): name what it can do (host commands, network, MCP tools, messages to other agents, settings, environment, file writes, starting agents, submitting prompts, running tools; hooks, including globs and negations, on tool verdicts, tool calls, prompts, agent spawns, tool descriptions, the transcript, compaction, model requests, other mods, or the file reads, settings and environment other mods decide by) in the transcript. "refuse-risky": refuse user-tier mods that can do any of those, unless listed in modTrustAllow. "off": do not watch.

modTrustAllow.title: Trusted mods (plugin ids)
